build_zoedepth_model: build a ZoeDepth model using ZoeDepth.build with pretrained weights for monocular depth estimation
build_zoedepth_from_config: build a ZoeDepth model from a config dictionary using ZoeDepth.build_from_config
run_zoedepth_forward: run forward pass on an image tensor through ZoeDepth to predict metric depth maps
get_zoedepth_lr_params: get learning rate parameter groups for ZoeDepth optimizer using get_lr_params method
load_zoedepth_state_dict: load a pretrained state dict into ZoeDepth using the overridden load_state_dict method
